notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Core product: behavioral insights + in-app search for enterprise customers.
Initial ask: replace home-grown TF-IDF search with vectored semantic search + hybrid reranking for 15M docs (events + help content).
They trialed Hosted API first for embeddings + similarity lookups; moving to evaluation for Dedicated for steady throughput and cost predictability.
Key quote on call: "We need predictable monthly cost — spikes in embedding ingestion killed our budget last quarter."
Preferred vector DBs: currently experimenting with Pinecone (managed) and Milvus (self-hosted). Want Redwood to integrate cleanly with both.
Batch pipeline: nightly Airflow job creating/updating vectors for incremental 200k docs/day; concerns about rate limiting and backpressure on hosted endpoints.
Throughput targets: ingest 200k embeddings/day (batch), support 400 concurrent semantic search QPS for product UI, 95th pctile search latency <120ms (end-to-end).
Model preferences: open embeddings models (instruction-tuned), evaluating Redwood-verified model profiles; interested in quantized variants for Dedicated to lower cost.
Security: SOC2 in progress, require SSO (SAML) for Console, audit logs for vector operations, and optional KMS integration for key management.
POC scope agreed: 1) ingestion benchmark (batch) 2) realtime semantic search latency under realistic client UX traffic 3) failover behavior to smaller model under load.
Notes from SE (Jordan): prototype uses prefix caching for common queries; observed KV cache hit pattern with product search templates.
Pricing sensitivity: want a committed monthly seat for Dedicated (3-6 month commit) vs pay-as-you-go hosted — financial model matters for final decision.
Redwood differentiators called out by customer: unified API across Hosted -> Dedicated, clear batching knobs, and rollout policies for model swaps.
Next demo items requested: can we show vector replication across regions? cost modeling for embedding batch jobs? Dedicated autoscaling behavior?
Action items from 2026-02-18 call: run 72-hour ingestion load test (Jordan + Redwood infra), deliver cost projection spreadsheet (Riley), legal to share SOW template.
